en: I think there's no way she could've made it all the way to the storage cart in the time the lights were out if that's really the fastest she can go...
ja: もしあれが本当に最速だとしたら、電気が消えてた時間で貯蔵車まで行けるとは思えない……

key: Does that help?
en: Does that help?
ja: これ、役に立った?

key: Why couldn't the pretty Gym Leader have come over to talk to me instead?
en: Why couldn't the pretty Gym Leader have come over to talk to me instead?
ja: どうしてあの可愛いジムリーダーの子じゃなくて、私のところに来てくれなかったんだろう?

key: Why that guy?
en: Why that guy?
ja: なんであの男なの?

key: Hey, something happened, right?
en: Hey, something happened, right?
ja: ねえ、何かあったんでしょ?

key: You might wanna check out the couple sitting across from me.
en: You might wanna check out the couple sitting across from me.
ja: あたしの向かいに座ってたカップルを調べてみたら?

key: I don't think they know the meaning about the word subtlety--
en: I don't think they know the meaning about the word subtlety--
ja: あの二人、控えめってものを知らないみたいでさ――

key: Before the lights went out, they were talking pretty loudly about pulling off some kind of stunt with this train.
en: Before the lights went out, they were talking pretty loudly about pulling off some kind of stunt with this train.
ja: 電気が消える前、この列車で何か企んでるみたいに大声で話してたよ。

key: Suspects 1 and 2 if you ask me.
en: Suspects 1 and 2 if you ask me.
ja: あたしに言わせりゃ、容疑者は一番と二番だね。

key: I'm annoyed.
en: I'm annoyed.
ja: むかつく。

key: That couple in there was definitely talking about pulling off a heist on this train.
en: That couple in there was definitely talking about pulling off a heist on this train.
ja: あそこにいたカップル、絶対にこの列車で強盗をやらかそうって話してた。

key: When the lights went out, I was so sure they were going to do it-- and that guy has been annoying me the whole ride.
en: When the lights went out, I was so sure they were going to do it-- and that guy has been annoying me the whole ride.
ja: 電気が消えたとき、絶対やるつもりだって確信したよ――それにあの男、旅の間中ずっとうざかったし。

key: I was gonna stick my leg out and trip him in the dark as soon as he started walking back to the storage car!
en: I was gonna stick my leg out and trip him in the dark as soon as he started walking back to the storage car!
ja: あいつが貯蔵車に向かって歩き出した瞬間、暗闇の中で足を出して転ばせてやろうと思ってたのに!

key: But he never did.
en: But he never did.
ja: でも結局あいつはそうしなかった。

key: A few others came and went, but he really was right there the whole time...
en: A few others came and went, but he really was right there the whole time...
ja: 他にも何人か行き来してたけど、あいつは本当にずっとそこにいたんだよ……

key: How I wish I could've seen him fall flat on his face...
en: How I wish I could've seen him fall flat on his face...
ja: あいつが顔からすっ転ぶところ、見たかったなぁ……

key: Champion \PN,
en: Champion \PN,
ja: チャンピオン\PN、

key: I don't have any evidence that your league colleague is definitely responsible for blowing up the engine,
en: I don't have any evidence that your league colleague is definitely responsible for blowing up the engine,
ja: あなたのリーグの仲間が機関部を爆破した犯人だと断言できる証拠は持っていませんが、

key: I'm just saying, I'd be more surprised if she didn't do it.
en: I'm just saying, I'd be more surprised if she didn't do it.
ja: ただ、彼女がやってなかったら逆に驚くだろうな、とは思いますね。

key: I was standing on guard back here at the time of the incident!
en: I was standing on guard back here at the time of the incident!
ja: 事件の時、あたしはこの後方で見張りをしてました!

key: First, I caught Sandy attempting to run into the storage room.
en: First, I caught Sandy attempting to run into the storage room.
ja: 最初に、サンディが貯蔵室に駆け込もうとしているのを捕まえました。

key: Then, someone else ran by me, but I couldn't catch them!
en: Then, someone else ran by me, but I couldn't catch them!
ja: それから、他の誰かが横を走り抜けていったんですが、捕まえられませんでした!

key: I heard a great deal of shuffling, a deep voice cried out, and then no more.
en: I heard a great deal of shuffling, a deep voice cried out, and then no more.
ja: 大きな物音、低い叫び声が聞こえて、それきり静かになりました。

key: Notably, I did not hear the back door of the storage cart open...
en: Notably, I did not hear the back door of the storage cart open...
ja: 注目すべきは、貯蔵車の裏口が開く音は聞かなかったということです……

key: But there seemed to be screaming coming from two carts down the line, so I wonder if that simply masked it...
en: But there seemed to be screaming coming from two carts down the line, so I wonder if that simply masked it...
ja: でも二両ほど先で悲鳴のような声がしていたので、それにかき消されただけかもしれないと思っています……

key: SANDY: It wasn't me! You have to believe me!
en: SANDY: It wasn't me! You have to believe me!
ja: サンディ: あたしじゃない! 信じて!

key: CHIEF: Is Sandy the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Sandy the culprit?
ja: チーフ: サンディが犯人ですか?

key: SANDY: Wait, no, \PN!
en: SANDY: Wait, no, \PN!
ja: サンディ: 待って、違う、\PN!

key: You're making a mistake!
en: You're making a mistake!
ja: あんた間違ってる!

key: It shouldn't have to be that way-- but there's still time! I'll change your mind yet!
en: It shouldn't have to be that way-- but there's still time!  I'll change your mind yet!
ja: こんなことにならなくてよかったのに――でもまだ時間はある! あんたの考え、絶対変えてみせるから!

key: All I ever wanted was to protect the planet, and I couldn't even do that!!!
en: All I ever wanted was to protect the planet, and I couldn't even do that!!!
ja: あたしがずっと望んでたのは地球を守ることだけなのに、それすらできなかった!!!

key: CHIEF: I see. Go on.
en: CHIEF: I see. Go on.
ja: チーフ: なるほど。続けて。

key: SANDY: The water coming out from your bag...
en: SANDY: The water coming out from your bag...
ja: サンディ: あんたのバッグから出てる水……

key: Do you think it's pristine?
en: Do you think it's pristine?
ja: それ、純粋なものだと思う?

key: Spring mineral, maybe?
en: Spring mineral, maybe?
ja: もしかして、天然のミネラルウォーターとか?

key: CRAUDBURRY: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR.
en: CRAUDBURRY: RRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR.
ja: クラウドバリー: ンンンンンンンンンンンンンンンンンンン。

key: CHIEF: Is Craudburry the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Craudburry the culprit?
ja: チーフ: クラウドバリーが犯人ですか?

key: CRAUDBURRY: How DARE you MISERABLE--
en: CRAUDBURRY: How DARE you MISERABLE--
ja: クラウドバリー: よくもこの惨めな――

key: You DECREPIT little--
en: You DECREPIT little--
ja: このボロボロの――

key: You--
en: You--
ja: あんた――

key: RAGGHDFDNAKSDSL!!!!!
en: RAGGHDFDNAKSDSL!!!!!
ja: ラアアアグッッハッフダフナクサドッスル!!!!

key: YARGGHARBFORGLRRGHGGHGH!
en: YARGGHARBFORGLRRGHGGHGH!
ja: ヤァァァグッハーブフォグルルルグッグッグ!

key: CRAUDBURRY: Back in my day, we didn't HAVE your fancy plastic water bottles!
en: CRAUDBURRY: Back in my day, we didn't HAVE your fancy plastic water bottles!
ja: クラウドバリー: 私の若い頃は、あんたたちの気取ったプラスチックボトルの水なんてなかったのよ!

key: If we didn't have our own canteen, we had to drink the SWEAT from our own ARMPITS!
en: If we didn't have our own canteen, we had to drink the SWEAT from our own ARMPITS!
ja: 自分の水筒を持っていなければ、自分のわきの下から出る汗を飲むしかなかったんだから!

key: BAAAAAAAH.
en: BAAAAAAAH.
ja: フンーーーーーーーーッ。

key: JOHN: Please, \PN.
en: JOHN: Please, \PN.
ja: ジョン: 頼むぞ、\PN。

key: Accuse an innocent man if you will.
en: Accuse an innocent man if you will.
ja: 何なら無実の男を疑うがいい。

key: Even this setback will not stop the return of Team Meteor.
en: Even this setback will not stop the return of Team Meteor.
ja: たとえこのつまずきがあろうと、Team Meteorの復活は止まらない。

key: CHIEF: Is John the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is John the culprit?
ja: チーフ: ジョンが犯人ですか?

key: JOHN: The obvious choice-- but a foolish and misguided one.
en: JOHN: The obvious choice-- but a foolish and misguided one.
ja: ジョン: いかにも見え透いた選択だ――だが愚かで見当違いなものでもある。

key: Nevertheless, I will fight for the glory of Meteor!
en: Nevertheless, I will fight for the glory of Meteor!
ja: それでも、俺はMeteorの栄光のために戦う!

key: Again with your belligerent opposition...
en: Again with your belligerent opposition...
ja: また貴様の好戦的な反抗か……

key: JOHN: So, it would seem you beat us to the punch...
en: JOHN: So, it would seem you beat us to the punch...
ja: ジョン: ふむ、どうやら我々より先に出し抜かれたようだな……

key: EUSTACE: You can't touch me.
en: EUSTACE: You can't touch me.
ja: ユースタス: 私には手出しできんぞ。

key: Don't even try.
en: Don't even try.
ja: 試みるだけ無駄だ。

key: CHIEF: Is Eustace the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Eustace the culprit?
ja: チーフ: ユースタスが犯人ですか?

key: EUSTACE: Preposterous.
en: EUSTACE: Preposterous.
ja: ユースタス: バカげている。

key: I've seen Dunsparce with more deductive ability than you.
en: I've seen Dunsparce with more deductive ability than you.
ja: ノコッチのほうがまだ推理力があるだろう。

key: I'll prove the difference in our intellect forcibly.
en: I'll prove the difference in our intellect forcibly.
ja: 私たちの知性の差を力ずくで証明してやろう。

key: This is balderdash. Someone see this farce put out at once! I insist!
en: This is balderdash. Someone see this farce put out at once! I insist!
ja: くだらん。誰かこの茶番をさっさと消してくれ! そう主張する!

key: EUSTACE: A classic caper, isn't it?
en: EUSTACE: A classic caper, isn't it?
ja: ユースタス: よくある古典的な事件だな?

key: The detective-- the thief.
en: The detective-- the thief.
ja: 探偵――泥棒。

key: Do not think yourself commendable.
en: Do not think yourself commendable.
ja: 自分を称賛に値すると思うなよ。

key: I would've done it much better.
en: I would've done it much better.
ja: 私ならもっとうまくやっていたはずだ。

key: Next time you attempt a heist, contact me.
en: Next time you attempt a heist, contact me.
ja: 今度強盗をたくらむときは、私に連絡することだ。

key: For 95% of the profits, I'll see it done flawlessly.
en: For 95% of the profits, I'll see it done flawlessly.
ja: 利益の95パーセントをよこせば、完璧にやり遂げてやろう。

key: The cop-- the thief.
en: The cop-- the thief.
ja: 警官――泥棒。

key: MAXWELL: Are we doing this again?
en: MAXWELL: Are we doing this again?
ja: マクスウェル: またこれをやるのか?

key: CHIEF: Is Maxwell the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Maxwell the culprit?
ja: チーフ: マクスウェルが犯人ですか?

key: MAXWELL: I should've figured you'd be determined to stand against me to the bitter end.
en: MAXWELL: I should've figured you'd be determined to stand against me to the bitter end.
ja: マクスウェル: お前は最後まで俺に逆らい続けるだろうと思っておくべきだったな。

key: So be it! Let's rage it out like a wildfire!
en: So be it! Let's rage it out like a wildfire!
ja: それでいい! 山火事みたいに派手に暴れようぜ!

key: Another loss, then... Hmph.
en: Another loss, then... Hmph.
ja: また負けか……フン。

key: ARCHER: It's quite obvious that I would be the wrong decision, but go on if you will.
en: ARCHER: It's quite obvious that I would be the wrong decision, but go on if you will.
ja: アーチャー: 私を選ぶのは明らかに間違いだが、そうしたいならどうぞ。

key: CHIEF: Is Archer the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Archer the culprit?
ja: チーフ: アーチャーが犯人ですか?

key: ARCHER: So you've made your choice-- and a wrong one.
en: ARCHER: So you've made your choice-- and a wrong one.
ja: アーチャー: 選んだようだな――そして間違った選択を。

key: Fear not, \PN.
en: Fear not, \PN.
ja: 恐れるな、\PN。

key: I won't let you make the wrong choice!
en: I won't let you make the wrong choice!
ja: お前に間違った選択をさせはしない!

key: Do you even understand the consequences of your actions?
en: Do you even understand the consequences of your actions?
ja: 自分の行動の結果を、本当に理解しているのか?

key: MAXWELL: I see what you've done.
en: MAXWELL: I see what you've done.
ja: マクスウェル: お前がやったこと、わかってるぞ。

key: ARCHER: It looks like you're the real Aqua Gang now.
en: ARCHER: It looks like you're the real Aqua Gang now.
ja: アーチャー: 今や、お前こそが本物のアクア団というわけだな。

key: JULIA: C'mon, you wouldn't actually do me in like this-- after everything we've been through?
en: JULIA: C'mon, you wouldn't actually do me in like this-- after everything we've been through?
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと、あたしたちがこれまで一緒に過ごしてきたのに――こんなふうに仕留めようとするの?

key: All the fun times, the explosions--
en: All the fun times, the explosions--
ja: 楽しい時間も、爆発も全部――

key: Or no, I suppose that's the problem here, huh...
en: Or no, I suppose that's the problem here, huh...
ja: いや、それが問題なのかもね……

key: CHIEF: Is Julia the culprit?
en: CHIEF: Is Julia the culprit?
ja: チーフ: ジュリアが犯人ですか?

key: JULIA: I am heartbroken!
en: JULIA: I am heartbroken!
ja: ジュリア: 傷ついた!

key: This is betrayal!
en: This is betrayal!
ja: これは裏切りだよ!

key: I won't take this lying down!
en: I won't take this lying down!
ja: 黙って引き下がったりしないから!

key: \PN, prepare for a counter-assault!
en: \PN, prepare for a counter-assault!
ja: \PN、反撃の覚悟をして!

key: Nooo! My freedom-- My freedom is slipping away!
en: Nooo! My freedom-- My freedom is slipping away!
ja: いやーーっ! あたしの自由が――自由が消えてく!

key: JULIA: Water you doing?!
en: JULIA: Water you doing?!
ja: ジュリア: バッグから何が出てるって?!

key: You have to check your bag quickly, or we're all shore to be in trouble!
en: You have to check your bag quickly, or we're all shore to be in trouble!
ja: 急いでバッグをチェックしないと、あたしたちみんな流されちゃうよ!

key: If you can't search yourself, I can do a pat-drown on you!
en: If you can't search yourself, I can do a pat-drown on you!
ja: 自分で調べられないなら、あたしがビシャッとチェックしてあげてもいいよ!

key: But seriously, if it keeps overflowing, this investigation's going to be all washed up!
en: But seriously, if it keeps overflowing, this investigation's going to be all washed up!
ja: でも本気で言うけど、あふれ続けたら、この捜査、水の泡になっちゃうよ!

key: Dive into your bag now!
en: Dive into your bag now!
ja: 今すぐバッグに飛び込んで確認して!

key: The Blue Orb could not be found in the possession of any of the primary suspects, but it's possible it was hidden somewhere like the Red Orb!
en: The Blue Orb could not be found in the possession of any of the primary suspects, but it's possible it was hidden somewhere like the Red Orb!
ja: 青の秘宝は主要容疑者の誰からも見つからなかったが、赤の秘宝のようにどこかに隠されている可能性がある!

key: The Blue Orb... Could it be?
en: The Blue Orb... Could it be?
ja: 青の秘宝……もしかして?

key: The chief has ordered that no one here is to leave the car until the situation is resolved.
en: The chief has ordered that no one here is to leave the car until the situation is resolved.
ja: チーフは、事態が解決するまで誰もこの車両を離れないよう命じている。

key: CHIEF: Report!
en: CHIEF: Report!
ja: チーフ: 報告を!

key: CONDUCTOR: I have the Red Orb right here!
en: CONDUCTOR: I have the Red Orb right here!
ja: コンダクター: 赤の秘宝はここにあります!

key: I was trying to see what repairs I could make to the engine, and I just...
en: I was trying to see what repairs I could make to the engine, and I just...
ja: 機関部の修理ができないか見ていたら、

key: Found it, inside.
en: Found it, inside.
ja: 中に入っているのを見つけたんです。

key: CHIEF: Inside the engine, you say?
en: CHIEF: Inside the engine, you say?
ja: チーフ: 機関部の中にあったと言うのですか?

key: CONDUCTOR: Yes, sir.
en: CONDUCTOR: Yes, sir.
ja: コンダクター: はい、そうです。

key: I have no idea how it could have gotten there-- the front end wasn't even accessible until I cleared away some of the debris.
en: I have no idea how it could have gotten there-- the front end wasn't even accessible until I cleared away some of the debris.
ja: どうやってそこに入ったのか、まったく見当もつきません――がれきを少し片付けるまで、前方には近づくことすらできなかったんです。

key: CHIEF: Give it here.
en: CHIEF: Give it here.
ja: チーフ: こちらに渡してください。

key: CHIEF: Hrrrm...
en: CHIEF: Hrrrm...
ja: チーフ: ふうむ……

key: I see! There's not a mark on it!
en: I see! There's not a mark on it!
ja: なるほど! 傷ひとつありませんね!

key: Even if it were sturdy enough to remain undamaged, if it were present at the time the engine exploded, we'd expect to see some kind of soot or grime on it!
en: Even if it were sturdy enough to remain undamaged, if it were present at the time the engine exploded, we'd expect to see some kind of soot or grime on it!
ja: 無傷でいられるほど頑丈だったとしても、爆発の瞬間にそこにあったのなら、すすや汚れが付いていておかしくないはずです!

key: This must have been placed in the engine at some point after the initial destruction!
en: This must have been placed in the engine at some point after the initial destruction!
ja: これは最初の破壊の後、どこかの時点で機関部に置かれたに違いありません!

key: EUSTACE: Obviously.
en: EUSTACE: Obviously.
ja: ユースタス: 当然だな。

key: Even a Basculin could deduce that.
en: Even a Basculin could deduce that.
ja: バスラオでもそれくらい推理できるだろう。

key: CHIEF: Silence, child.
en: CHIEF: Silence, child.
ja: チーフ: 静かに、坊や。

key: You'll speak when spoken to.
en: You'll speak when spoken to.
ja: 話しかけられたときだけ話しなさい。

key: EUSTACE: And whenever else I please.
en: EUSTACE: And whenever else I please.
ja: ユースタス: そして私が話したいときにも、な。

key: CHIEF: Officer, did your search yield anything?
en: CHIEF: Officer, did your search yield anything?
ja: チーフ: 警官、捜索で何か見つかりましたか?

key: OFFICER: No, sir!
en: OFFICER: No, sir!
ja: 警官: いいえ、何も!

key: We thoroughly searched all six primary suspects, and there is no sign of the Blue Orb!
en: We thoroughly searched all six primary suspects, and there is no sign of the Blue Orb!
ja: 主要容疑者六人を徹底的に捜索しましたが、青の秘宝の痕跡はありませんでした!

key: CRAUDBURRY: And you violated at least EIGHT privacy laws in the process!
en: CRAUDBURRY: And you violated at least EIGHT privacy laws in the process!
ja: クラウドバリー: それに、その過程で少なくとも八つのプライバシー法を犯したわね!

key: Young man couldn't resist getting a pat and feel in on this lady, could you?
en: Young man couldn't resist getting a pat and feel in on this lady, could you?
ja: 若いの、この私にボディタッチせずにはいられなかったんでしょう?

key: Can't say I blame you, but I don't want your GRUBBY PAWS coming near me any time in the future!
en: Can't say I blame you, but I don't want your GRUBBY PAWS coming near me any time in the future!
ja: 責めるつもりはないけど、これから先、あんたの汚らしい手を私に近づけてほしくないわね!

key: OFFICER: I took no pleasure in it, ma'am.
en: OFFICER: I took no pleasure in it, ma'am.
ja: 警官: 少しも楽しんでなどいませんよ、お嬢様。

key: With all due respect, I would rather eat the entire Tourmaline Desert one spoonful of sand at a time than touch you again.
en: With all due respect, I would rather eat the entire Tourmaline Desert one spoonful of sand at a time than touch you again.
ja: 失礼ながら、あなたにもう一度触れるくらいなら、トルマリン砂漠をスプーン一杯ずつ全部食べたほうがマシです。

key: CRAUDBURRY: You FOUL-MOUTHED BARBARIAN!
en: CRAUDBURRY: You FOUL-MOUTHED BARBARIAN!
ja: クラウドバリー: この口の悪い蛮族が!

key: When we get back to the city, I'll SUE YOU SIDEWAYS!
en: When we get back to the city, I'll SUE YOU SIDEWAYS!
ja: 街に戻ったら、あんたを徹底的に訴えてやる!

key: I'll make you REGRET the day you ever crawled out of your mother's STINKING HOLE and--
en: I'll make you REGRET the day you ever crawled out of your mother's STINKING HOLE and--
ja: 自分の母親の臭い穴からはい出てきた日を後悔させてやるわ、それと――

key: CHIEF: Ma'am.
en: CHIEF: Ma'am.
ja: チーフ: お嬢様。

key: If you speak one more word, I will personally throw you out of this train and strand you in the desert.
en: If you speak one more word, I will personally throw you out of this train and strand you in the desert.
ja: もう一言でも発したら、私自らこの列車からあなたを放り出して、砂漠に置き去りにしますよ。

key: CHIEF: The Red Orb was found at the opposite side of the train from where it was stolen.
en: CHIEF: The Red Orb was found at the opposite side of the train from where it was stolen.
ja: チーフ: 赤の秘宝は、盗まれた場所とは反対側で見つかりました。

key: The Blue Orb is still missing.
en: The Blue Orb is still missing.
ja: 青の秘宝はまだ行方不明です。

key: I'm beginning to have my suspicions...
en: I'm beginning to have my suspicions...
ja: 疑いが芽生えてきました……

key: But before that, \PN...
en: But before that, \PN...
ja: だがその前に、\PN……

key: Tell me the results of your investigation.
en: Tell me the results of your investigation.
ja: あなたの捜査結果を聞かせてください。

key: Presumably you spoke to each of these suspects.
en: Presumably you spoke to each of these suspects.
ja: 容疑者全員と話したはずですね。

key: Please now talk to the person you find most suspicious here.
en: Please now talk to the person you find most suspicious here.
ja: では、ここで最も怪しいと思う人物と話してください。

key: CHIEF: Simply talk to the person that you find most suspicious, and we'll go from there.
en: CHIEF: Simply talk to the person that you find most suspicious, and we'll go from there.
ja: チーフ: 単純に、最も怪しいと思う人物と話してください。そこから進めましょう。

key: Any one of them will do, no?
en: Any one of them will do, no?
ja: 誰でも構いませんよね?

key: CHIEF: Go on-- talk to any of the suspects.
en: CHIEF: Go on-- talk to any of the suspects.
ja: チーフ: さあ――容疑者の誰かと話してください。

key: Whoever you find most suspicious.
en: Whoever you find most suspicious.
ja: 最も怪しいと思う相手なら誰でも。

key: CHIEF: You... keep talking to me.
en: CHIEF: You... keep talking to me.
ja: チーフ: あなた……私にばかり話しかけますね。

key: Don't tell me...
en: Don't tell me...
ja: まさか……

key: Could it be that you actually find me to be suspicious?
en: Could it be that you actually find me to be suspicious?
ja: もしかして、この私を怪しいと思っているのですか?

key: CHIEF: Oh-ho.
en: CHIEF: Oh-ho.
ja: チーフ: おやおや。

key: You are right, young Champion, to be suspicious of everyone and everything!
en: You are right, young Champion, to be suspicious of everyone and everything!
ja: その通りです、若きチャンピオン、あらゆる人とあらゆる物を疑うのは正しい姿勢です!

key: Make no assumptions!
en: Make no assumptions!
ja: 決めつけをしないこと!

key: Take nothing for granted!
en: Take nothing for granted!
ja: 当たり前だと思わないこと!

key: These are the hallmarks of a truly astute detective!
en: These are the hallmarks of a truly astute detective!
ja: これこそが真に鋭い探偵の証です!

key: But I'm afraid your cunning will not be rewarded this time.
en: But I'm afraid your cunning will not be rewarded this time.
ja: ですが残念ながら、今回はその機知も報われないでしょう。

key: Officer!
en: Officer!
ja: 警官!

key: Please search the accused.
en: Please search the accused.
ja: 被疑者の身体検査をお願いします。

key: OFFICER: Y-you mean... you, sir?
en: OFFICER: Y-you mean... you, sir?
ja: 警官: そ、それはつまり……あなたのことですか?

key: CHIEF: Precisely!
en: CHIEF: Precisely!
ja: チーフ: その通り!

key: The Blue Orb is still missing!
en: The Blue Orb is still missing!
ja: 青の秘宝はまだ見つかっていません!

key: If I am the culprit, I should have it on my person, should I not?
en: If I am the culprit, I should have it on my person, should I not?
ja: もし私が犯人なら、私自身が持っているはずでしょう?

key: OFFICER: All clean, sir!
en: OFFICER: All clean, sir!
ja: 警官: 何もありません、閣下!

key: CHIEF: So you see, it couldn't be me!
en: CHIEF: So you see, it couldn't be me!
ja: チーフ: ほら、私であるはずがないでしょう!

key: For if it were, where could I have hidden the Blue Orb?!
en: For if it were, where could I have hidden the Blue Orb?!
ja: もし私だとしたら、一体どこに青の秘宝を隠せたというのです?!

key: Until you can answer that, there's simply--
en: Until you can answer that, there's simply--
ja: それに答えられるまで、単純に――

key: CHIEF: ...
en: CHIEF: ...
ja: チーフ: ……

key: JULIA: Um, \PN?
en: JULIA: Um, \PN?
ja: ジュリア: あの、\PN?

key: Why is water coming out of your bag?
en: Why is water coming out of your bag?
ja: なんであんたのバッグから水が出てるの?

key: CRAUDBURRY: BAH. Youth these days don't even know how to store WATER right.
en: CRAUDBURRY: BAH. Youth these days don't even know how to store WATER right.
ja: クラウドバリー: フンッ。最近の若者は水の保存方法すら知らないのね。

key: SANDY: \PN, check your bag!
en: SANDY: \PN, check your bag!
ja: サンディ: \PN、バッグを確認して!

key: CHIEF: Ha-ha!
en: CHIEF: Ha-ha!
ja: チーフ: ハハッ!

key: Of course not!
en: Of course not!
ja: もちろん違いますよ!

key: That would be ridiculous after all,
en: That would be ridiculous after all,
ja: そんなの、あまりにばかげていますからね、

key: But a good joke, \PN!
en: But a good joke, \PN!
ja: でもいいジョークです、\PN!

key: Quality humor from a quality champion.
en: Quality humor from a quality champion.
ja: さすがチャンピオン、上質なユーモアだ。

key: CHIEF: Order! Order, I say!
en: CHIEF: Order! Order, I say!
ja: チーフ: 静粛に! 静粛にと言っているんです!

key: This is NOT due process!
en: This is NOT due process!
ja: これは正当な手続きではありません!

key: Everyone stand down!
en: Everyone stand down!
ja: 全員、動きを止めてください!

key: We'll take the accused into custody, and then--
en: We'll take the accused into custody, and then--
ja: 被疑者を拘束します。そして――

key: CHIEF: I believe you should check your bag, young Champion.
en: CHIEF: I believe you should check your bag, young Champion.
ja: チーフ: 若きチャンピオン、あなたはバッグを確認すべきだと思いますよ。

key: You may have just what we're looking for...
en: You may have just what we're looking for...
ja: 探していたものが入っているかもしれません……

key: CHIEF: ...Why now, of all times...
en: CHIEF: ...Why now, of all times...
ja: チーフ: ……よりによって、なぜ今……

key: CHIEF: Impossible!
en: CHIEF: Impossible!
ja: チーフ: まさか!

key: The Blue Orb was in your bag all along?!
en: The Blue Orb was in your bag all along?!
ja: 青の秘宝はずっとあなたのバッグの中に?!

key: How could this be?
en: How could this be?
ja: どうしてこんなことに?

key: Quickly, give it here, and we'll have restored the set!
en: Quickly, give it here, and we'll have restored the set!
ja: さあ早く、こちらに渡してください。これでセットがそろいます!

key: \PN handed over the Blue Orb.
en: \PN handed over the Blue Orb.
ja: \PNは青の秘宝を差し出した。

key: EUSTACE: Officer, do you mean to say that we've been accused of thievery despite the fact that the orb's caretaker had it the entire time?
en: EUSTACE: Officer, do you mean to say that we've been accused of thievery despite the fact that the orb's caretaker had it the entire time?
ja: ユースタス: 警官、秘宝の管理人がずっと持っていたのに、私たちは窃盗の容疑をかけられていたと、そう言いたいのか?

key: How dare you waste all of our time and energy on this?!
en: How dare you waste all of our time and energy on this?!
ja: よくもこれだけ私たちの時間と労力を無駄にしてくれたな!?

key: Some of us have places to be, you know!
en: Some of us have places to be, you know!
ja: 私たちの中には行く場所がある者もいるのだぞ!

key: JOHN: You had nowhere to be, child-- we are all trapped on this train.
en: JOHN: You had nowhere to be, child-- we are all trapped on this train.
ja: ジョン: お前には行く場所などなかっただろう、坊や――我々は皆この列車に閉じ込められているのだ。

key: ARCHER: Pardon me, but something is amiss here.
en: ARCHER: Pardon me, but something is amiss here.
ja: アーチャー: 失礼だが、何かがおかしい。

key: For what purpose, exactly, did \PN even have it?
en: For what purpose, exactly, did \PN even have it?
ja: そもそも\PNは、何の目的でそれを持っていたんだ?

key: What was the endgame here?
en: What was the endgame here?
ja: この一件の最終目的は何だったんだ?

key: MAXWELL: Wait, why did \PN even have the orb?
en: MAXWELL: Wait, why did \PN even have the orb?
ja: マクスウェル: 待てよ、なんで\PNが秘宝を持ってたんだ?

key: What was the point of any of this?
en: What was the point of any of this?
ja: これ全部、一体何のためだったんだ?

key: CHIEF: As it were, I do have my own theories about that...
en: CHIEF: As it were, I do have my own theories about that...
ja: チーフ: それについては、私なりの推理がありますよ……

key: Let us consider, \PN was trusted and assigned to guard the orbs, but was not given proper custody of them.
en: Let us consider, \PN was trusted and assigned to guard the orbs, but was not given proper custody of them.
ja: 考えてみましょう、\PNは信頼されて秘宝の護衛を任されましたが、正式な管理権は与えられていませんでした。

key: After the lights went out, \PN came forward to the engine to report that they had been stolen.
en: After the lights went out, \PN came forward to the engine to report that they had been stolen.
ja: 明かりが消えた後、\PNは秘宝が盗まれたと報告しに機関部までやってきました。

key: I left to investigate... and the Red Orb would later be found in the engine room!
en: I left to investigate... and the Red Orb would later be found in the engine room!
ja: 私は調査のために離れました……そして後に赤の秘宝が機関室で見つかったのです!

key: Conductor!
en: Conductor!
ja: コンダクター!

key: Was there any point after I left the room during which \PN could have stowed the Red Orb safely away in the debris?
en: Was there any point after I left the room during which \PN could have stowed the Red Orb safely away in the debris?
ja: 私が部屋を離れた後、\PNが赤の秘宝をがれきの中に安全にしまい込む機会はありましたか?

key: Perhaps if you looked away for just the wrong moment...
en: Perhaps if you looked away for just the wrong moment...
ja: もしかすると、ほんの一瞬、目を離した瞬間があったのでは……

key: CONDUCTOR: Uh, well... I don't know.
en: CONDUCTOR: Uh, well... I don't know.
ja: コンダクター: えっと、その……わかりません。

key: I don't think so?
en: I don't think so?
ja: ないと思いますが?

key: The compartment that it was found in was blocked from the front, so it would've been difficult.
en: The compartment that it was found in was blocked from the front, so it would've been difficult.
ja: 見つかった区画は前方から塞がれていたので、それは難しかったと思います。

key: CHIEF: But can you say, with 100% certainty that \PN couldn't have hidden it there?
en: CHIEF: But can you say, with 100% certainty that \PN couldn't have hidden it there?
ja: チーフ: しかし、\PNがそこに隠せなかったと100パーセント断言できますか?

key: One hundred percent, Conductor! Not one less!
en: One hundred percent, Conductor! Not one less!
ja: 100パーセントですよ、コンダクター! 1パーセントも欠けることなく!

key: CONDUCTOR: I... guess I can't be that certain?
en: CONDUCTOR: I... guess I can't be that certain?
ja: コンダクター: そこまでは……断言できないかもしれません?

key: CHIEF: There you have it!
en: CHIEF: There you have it!
ja: チーフ: そら、ご覧なさい!

key: \PN must have been plotting to steal the orbs all along!
en: \PN must have been plotting to steal the orbs all along!
ja: \PNは最初から秘宝を盗む計画を立てていたに違いありません!

key: Frame an innocent, and come back to collect them later...
en: Frame an innocent, and come back to collect them later...
ja: 無実の者に罪をなすりつけて、後で回収しに戻る……

key: It's just a stroke of luck that there wasn't a chance to hide the Blue Orb!
en: It's just a stroke of luck that there wasn't a chance to hide the Blue Orb!
ja: 青の秘宝を隠す機会がなかったのは、単なる運の良さです!

key: Perhaps this could have been expected...
en: Perhaps this could have been expected...
ja: もしかすると、これは予想できたことかもしれません……

key: For the Champion, who is used to always winning--
en: For the Champion, who is used to always winning--
ja: いつも勝つことに慣れているチャンピオンには――

key: Used to always getting everything there is to get, simply because it exists...
en: Used to always getting everything there is to get, simply because it exists...
ja: 存在するものすべてを、ただそこにあるという理由だけで手に入れることに慣れている者には……

key: It is only understandable, though tragic, that such a person should fall victim to entitlement...
en: It is only understandable, though tragic, that such a person should fall victim to entitlement...
ja: そのような人物が特権意識の犠牲になるのは、悲劇ではあっても理解できることです……

key: JULIA: Hold on, your story doesn't make sense!
en: JULIA: Hold on, your story doesn't make sense!
ja: ジュリア: ちょっと待って、あんたの話、筋が通ってないよ!

key: You said \PN stole the orbs when the lights went out, but how did they even make the lights go out when they were all the way at the other end of the train?!
en: You said \PN stole the orbs when the lights went out, but how did they even make the lights go out when they were all the way at the other end of the train?!
ja: 明かりが消えたときに\PNが秘宝を盗んだって言うけど、列車の反対側の端にいたのに、どうやって明かりを消せたっていうの?!

key: ARCHER: ...I have one idea.
en: ARCHER: ...I have one idea.
ja: アーチャー: ……ひとつ考えがある。

key: It's as you yourself said in our hypothetical discussion-- one person could flip the lights, while another steals the orbs.
en: It's as you yourself said in our hypothetical discussion-- one person could flip the lights, while another steals the orbs.
ja: お前自身が我々の仮定の会話の中で言っていた通りだ――一人が明かりを消し、もう一人が秘宝を盗む。

key: Simple, really.
en: Simple, really.
ja: 実に単純だな。

key: MAXWELL: ...Well, I hate to do this...
en: MAXWELL: ...Well, I hate to do this...
ja: マクスウェル: ……こんなことしたくねえんだが……

key: But weren't you the one who said that you could distract the Conductor long enough to flip the lights and give someone else cover to steal them?
en: But weren't you the one who said that you could distract the Conductor long enough to flip the lights and give someone else cover to steal them?
ja: お前、コンダクターの気をそらして明かりを消す時間を稼ぎ、他の誰かに盗む機会をカバーできるって言ってなかったか?

key: JULIA: You!
en: JULIA: You!
ja: ジュリア: あんた!

key: How could you!?
en: How could you!?
ja: よくもそんな!

key: I was going to KISS you!
en: I was going to KISS you!
ja: あんたにキスしてあげようとしてたのに!

key: That was a private, and strictly theoretical discussion!!!
en: That was a private, and strictly theoretical discussion!!!
ja: あれは二人だけの、あくまで仮定の話だったのに!!!

key: ARCHER: Please calm down.
en: ARCHER: Please calm down.
ja: アーチャー: 落ち着いてくれ。

key: I am not accusing you.
en: I am not accusing you.
ja: お前を責めているわけではない。

key: I am just saying that it's possible \PN has an accomplice.
en: I am just saying that it's possible \PN has an accomplice.
ja: ただ、\PNに共犯者がいる可能性があると言っているだけだ。

key: MAXWELL: Listen, I'm not saying you did it.
en: MAXWELL: Listen, I'm not saying you did it.
ja: マクスウェル: なあ、お前がやったって言ってるわけじゃねえよ。

key: I'm just saying, it's possible \PN has an accomplice.
en: I'm just saying, it's possible \PN has an accomplice.
ja: ただ、\PNに共犯者がいる可能性があるって言ってるだけだ。

key: CHIEF: A fair point, which raises the question: Just how did the lights go out?
en: CHIEF: A fair point, which raises the question: Just how did the lights go out?
ja: チーフ: もっともな指摘ですね。それが疑問を生みます。一体どうやって明かりが消えたのでしょう?

key: Were they turned off manually? Or forcibly cut?
en: Were they turned off manually? Or forcibly cut?
ja: 手動で切られたのか? それとも強制的に切断されたのか?

key: Conductor?
en: Conductor?
ja: コンダクター?

key: CONDUCTOR: I don't think they were flipped--
en: CONDUCTOR: I don't think they were flipped--
ja: コンダクター: スイッチが切られたとは思えません――

key: There was no one else there at the time, at least as far as I knew.
en: There was no one else there at the time, at least as far as I knew.
ja: 少なくとも私の知る限り、その時あの場所には他に誰もいませんでした。

key: CHIEF: I would like to check for myself to be certain.
en: CHIEF: I would like to check for myself to be certain.
